name: Village of Decline - The Darkest Outcome
source:
A worrying letter has arrived from the remote village of Dernsbog: our thus-far reliable informant has sent an incoherent message, hinting at an impending disaster on the day after it celebrates the Solstice festival. You are to send a team of pawns to investigate; and, should they find anything, to put an immediate stop to it. The situation is unknown and potentially dangerous. We trust that the trio you send will be able to handle it.

[From [url=https://orbitalcrypt.itch.io/village-of-decline-the-darkest-outcome]itch.io[/url]]
